scientific_integrity: The infinite claim is proved symbolically from Pell identities and a strong-divisibility GCD step. The bundled computation is a regression check and is not used as an infinite proof. Originality is assessed against the focal open question, the preceding generalized-Fibonacci square-sum paper, targeted database searches, and available indexed literature.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats odd window lengths only and does not determine the even branch or the cobalancing and Lucas-cobalancing square-sum GCDs. The exact value is reduced to gcd(B_k,k), whose prime-factor closed form is a separate sequence-index problem.
title: Odd-window square-sum GCDs for balancing and Lucas-balancing sequences
